scopeBasis: Slot-free writes to county_facet_coverage only. Code/run from P:/seat-worktrees/property/legacy-design-tools. Doc_repo writes this lane's _inbox JSON. Stock countyFloodScoreCli.ts --county= still runs readAtomCountsByCounty (lines 105-121, called at 287 before the county filter), which is left(entity_id,5) GROUP BY all flood-hazard-fact. Dispatch announce is per-county indexed reads, not a full-table atoms scan. Execution therefore uses a tmp runner that keeps the CLI's scoreFlood + upsert SQL and replaces atom discovery with prefix-range COUNT on (entity_type, entity_id). Feature denom stays count(DISTINCT feature_index) FROM txgio_parcel WHERE county_fips=$1. Exclude Donley. Do not score geometry 48135. Harris 48201 not-yet under 95% is a valid score.
